name: LoopBuf
description: Sample-looping oscillator. Plays a buffer with sustain looping between startLoop and endLoop frames. Positive gate restarts from startPos; negative gate plays the rest of the sample from the current position without looping. By Lance Putnam. From sc3-plugins LoopBufUGens.

inputs.name: numChannels
inputs.description: Number of channels in the buffer — fixed at SynthDef compile time. Must match the buffer's channel count or the UGen fails silently

inputs.name: bufnum
inputs.description: Index of the buffer to play

inputs.name: gate
inputs.description: Positive gate restarts from startPos. Negative gate plays the remainder of the sample without looping

inputs.name: startPos
inputs.description: Sample frame to start playback from

inputs.name: startLoop
inputs.description: Sample frame of the start of the loop

inputs.name: endLoop
inputs.description: Sample frame of the end of the loop
